title: Kazakhstan Secures Export License for 45,000 Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
summary:
A computing project in partnership with Kazakhtelecom has received government approval to import a large shipment of high-end processors to power the nation's new artificial intelligence infrastructure. The order consists of 45,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs, with the facility's first phase scheduled to launch in Q3 2027. Once the project completes its second phase, total power capacity is projected to reach 500 MW.

The hardware acquisition follows a visit to Astana by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who stated that Kazakhstan is positioned to become an AI computing hub for the European region. The rollout is part of a broader strategy to develop a local ecosystem involving partners like Firebird AI KZ and Higgsfield, for which Huang was recently awarded the Order of Dostyk, First Class, by President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.
